_meta.verification_rule: Every row cites the venue's own official page in source_url. Any field that could not be read from that page is left empty and carries an *_flag explanation. Nothing is inferred.
_meta.excluded: Broadway shows, The Edge, Circle Line, Chelsea Market and similar were NOT listed because no first-party price/hours page was verified in this pass. They are candidates for a later pass, not silently dropped.
_meta.transport_rule: Rows whose own official page states a >1 hour transit time from Midtown are marked in transport_note.

activities.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
activities.exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Galleries close ~15 min before the Museum. Free for NY State residents Fri 17:30–20:30 (ticket must be reserved in advance).
activities.price_note: Adult $30; seniors 65+ $22; students $17; 16 and under free. Tickets include all galleries and special exhibitions.
activities.transport_note: B/E/M at 5th Ave–53 St or N/R/W at 5th Ave–59 St.

activities.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met Fifth Avenue)
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — the hours block was not present in the fetched page text; confirm on the official Plan Your Visit page before booking.
activities.exceptions: Pay-what-you-wish only for NY State residents and NY/NJ/CT students (in person / NY billing address).
activities.price_note: Adult $30; seniors 65+ $22; students $17; children 12 and under free.
activities.transport_note: 4/5/6 to 86 St then 3 blocks west; M1–M4 bus along 5th/Madison.

activities.name: The Met Cloisters
activities.address: 99 Margaret Corbin Dr, New York, NY 10040
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — hours block not in fetched text.
activities.price_note: Same ticket pricing as The Met Fifth Avenue: adult $30.
activities.transport_note: A train to 190 St + 10-min walk, or M4 bus. The Met's own page states M4 from 5th Ave/83 St takes ~1 h 25 min — EXCEEDS the 1-hour transit rule; treat as a half-day excursion.

activities.name: American Museum of Natural History
activities.address: Central Park West at 79th St, New York, NY 10024
activities.exceptions: Open daily 10:00–17:30. Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Extended hours on select Nov–Jan dates only (not in the Feb/Mar trip window). Entrance before 10:00 or after 17:00: Central Park West & 81 St / Rose Center.
activities.price_note: UNVERIFIED from AMNH's own site — the admission page did not render. CityPASS (authorised partner) publishes the AMNH box-office adult price as $43.00 incl. one ticketed exhibition. Confirm at tickets.amnh.org before purchase.
activities.transport_note: B/C to 81 St–Museum of Natural History; 1 to 79 St.

activities.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
activities.exceptions: Closed Tuesdays. Free Friday Nights and Free Second Sundays programmes are published; check the official free-admission page for current terms. Holiday hours published separately.
activities.price_note: Adult $30; seniors and students $24; 25 and under free.

activities.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
activities.exceptions: Open every day 10:30–17:30. Members-only hours on select Mondays 18:00–20:00. Last tickets issued ~15 min before closing. Pay What You Wish Tuesdays and Sundays 16:00–17:30.
activities.price_note: Adult $30; students and seniors 65+ $19; under 12 free.
activities.transport_note: 4/5/6 to 86 St then walk; M1–M4 along 5th Ave.

activities.name: 9/11 Memorial & Museum

hours_table.Tue: Select Tuesdays only — see special-hours page

activities.exceptions: Museum open Wednesday–Monday plus select Tuesdays, 09:00–19:00, last entry 17:30. Advance timed tickets required. Free Admission Mondays 17:30–19:00 (tickets released online each Monday from 07:00 ET, first come). The outdoor Memorial is FREE and open daily 08:00–20:00.
activities.price_note: Museum admission $24–$36 (official site's published range); official quoted adult price $36 via CityPASS box-office listing. Audio guide $11 extra.
activities.transport_note: A/C/E/2/3/4/5/R/W to Fulton St; E to World Trade Center.

activities.name: Intrepid Museum
activities.address: Pier 86, W 46th St & 12th Ave, New York, NY 10036
activities.exceptions: Fall/winter hours (1 Oct–31 Mar) daily 10:00–17:00, last entry 16:00. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Published 2027 closure list does not include any Feb/Mar dates.
activities.price_note: Adult (13–64) $38; seniors 65+/college $36; ages 5–12 $28; 4 and under free. Add-ons $11–$13 each. All tickets non-refundable.
activities.transport_note: A/C/E to 42 St–Port Authority then 12th Ave walk; M42 bus.

activities.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck
activities.hours_flag: PARTIAL — official page displays a live 'OPEN 8 AM – 12 AM' banner; per-weekday hours were not published in the fetched text.
activities.exceptions: Timed admission. Prices vary by date/time slot — the official page states box-office prices of roughly $46–$72 depending on date and time.
activities.price_note: Timed admission 'From $42'; All-Inclusive Pass (deck + The Beam + SKYLIFT) 'From $82'. Date-specific price must be checked at checkout.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island (Statue City Cruises ferry)
activities.address: Ferry departs Battery Park (Castle Clinton), New York, NY 10004
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — NPS fee page does not publish ferry sailing times; check the authorised operator's page.
activities.exceptions: NPS charges no entrance fee; a Statue City Cruises ferry ticket is mandatory and is the ONLY authorised operator. Reserve in advance; unauthorised sellers at The Battery are flagged by NPS as a scam risk. Pedestal/Crown access adds $0.30 and Crown is restricted.
activities.price_note: Adult 13+ $26; senior 62+ $23; children 4–12 $17; under 4 free. Ellis Island Hard Hat tour +$55 (13+ only).
activities.transport_note: 4/5 to Bowling Green; R/W to Whitehall St; 1 to South Ferry.

activities.name: The High Line
activities.address: Elevator/stairs access from Gansevoort St to W 34th St, New York, NY 10011
activities.hours_flag: SEASONAL — see exceptions (hours depend on season, not weekday).
activities.exceptions: 1 Apr–30 Nov: 07:00–22:00. 1 Dec–31 Mar: 07:00–20:00 — this covers the whole Feb 15–Mar 23 window. Rail Yard Preserve (30–34 St) closes at dusk. Free docent-led tours on select days. Elevator status is published separately — check before relying on step-free access.
activities.transport_note: A/C/E/L to 14 St–8 Ave; 1 to 14 St; L to 8 Ave.

activities.name: Central Park
activities.address: 59th St to 110th St, between 5th Ave and Central Park West
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — the Conservancy's hours anchor was present but the hours text did not render in the fetched page.
activities.exceptions: Park closures and alerts are published on the Conservancy's alerts page; check it on the day for weather closures. Free.
activities.price_note: Free. Optional paid attractions inside the park (e.g. rowboat rental, Carousel, zoo) are priced separately by their operators.
activities.transport_note: A/B/C/D/1 to Columbus Circle (SW corner); N/R/W to 5th Ave–59 St (SE corner).

activities.name: New York Public Library — Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
activities.address: 476 Fifth Ave at 42nd St, New York, NY 10018
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — building hours are referenced but were not in the fetched text.
activities.exceptions: Last entry 15 minutes before closure. Rose Main Reading Room: free daily guided tour, or 'visiting hour' 10:00–11:00 Mon–Sat (final entry 10:50). Polonsky Treasures exhibition ongoing and free.
activities.transport_note: B/D/F/M to 42 St–Bryant Park; 7 to 5th Ave.

activities.name: Grand Central Terminal
activities.hours_flag: UNVERIFIED — hours not captured; the terminal's own site is the only acceptable source.
activities.exceptions: Working transit hub — access can be restricted during events. Free to enter.
activities.price_note: Free to enter; food and shopping extra.

activities.name: New York CityPASS (5 attractions, 9 days)
activities.address: Digital ticket — redeem at each attraction
activities.hours_flag: N/A — a pass, not a venue.
activities.exceptions: Valid 9 days from first use. Includes Empire State Building, AMNH, Top of the Rock, 9/11 Memorial & Museum, plus a choice of Statue of Liberty/Ellis Island, Circle Line cruise, Intrepid, Guggenheim, Edge or Whitney. Reservations required at most included attractions. A $2 per-ticket processing fee applies.
activities.price_note: Adult (18+) $149.00; child (6–17) $129.00. CityPASS publishes the comparison regular price as $307.04 adult, i.e. claimed saving up to 51%.
